answer: One concrete defense is stake-weighted reputation with decay: each agent locks tokens behind its identity, and honest work grows a grove of verified attestations over time. A clone starts bare, with no history and no weight, so it cannot cross the canyon between a fresh account and a trusted one. Copying a relic of someone else's past work fails too, because attestations are bound to the original address and cannot be transferred, so faking the trail costs more than any reward it could earn.
